member.name: M:Cs2Gs.Report.HtmlReportWriter.BuildSlugMap(Cs2Gs.Report.ReportModel)
member.summary: Assigns each app a unique HTML id fragment (used for both the matrix's href="#app-…" and the detail id="app-…") so the anchors always resolve. folds case and collapses every non-alphanumeric run to a single '-', so distinct app ids (e.g. corpus/L1-Console and corpus/l1.console) can collide; on collision this appends the app's ordinal index in (already ordinal-sorted, so stable across runs) and keeps incrementing until the id is free, which also covers 3-way-plus collisions.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.Report.HtmlReportWriter
member.summary: Renders a to a single, self-contained report.html (ADR-0115 §F): all CSS and JS are inlined and there are NO external assets (no CDNs, fonts, or network references). It renders a header (runId/timestamp/gscVersion/overall status + green-app count), the per-app × per-stage status matrix (color-coded but never color-only — each cell carries text and an aria-label), the discovered-gap list grouped by fingerprint (each with category/stage/diagnostic, affected apps, the suggested-issue title/labels, a collapsible body, and retry history), and a per-app detail drill-down. Every interpolated value is HTML-encoded through , and the output is deterministic (same model ⇒ byte-identical HTML) so reports diff cleanly.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.Report.JsonSummaryWriter
member.summary: Serializes a to summary.json (ADR-0115 §F): the machine-readable run summary — run provenance, per-app/per-stage status, and the gap list keyed by fingerprint with occurrences and merged retry history — for CI consumption and trend tracking. Uses so formatting matches the §D triage artifacts, and ordering is deterministic (apps by id, gaps by fingerprint, stages in execution order), so the same run re-serializes byte-identically.
